description: This file defines the authentication routes for a FastAPI-based web application, including signup, login, and current user profile endpoints.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Schema representing the authentication token, including access token and token type.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema used for user registration, containing email, password, and optional full name.

classes.name: UserLogin
classes.description: Schema used for user login requests, containing email and password.

classes.name: UserRead
classes.description: Schema for representing user data in responses, excluding sensitive fields.

methods.name: signup(payload: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with provided details.

methods.name: login(payload: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user and retrieve a JWT token.

methods.name: me(current_user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch the current authenticated user's profile.
